title: Dynamic (behavioral) view — evidence-validated step list
description: The engine §6.9(c) artifact for one scenario (`generated/views/dynamic/<slug>.json`) and the `validated_view` subtree of a `scenario-candidate/1` envelope. The ordered step list of a dynamic (sequence) view, each step validated against the BUILD container graph OR the RUNTIME deployment facet (dynamic-view plan §0.3/§3.1). Anon computes this; serve echoes it verbatim; the GUI <SequenceStrip> renders it (engine §2.1 iron rule). The validator's green check evidences edge EXISTENCE only, never call ORDER — `ordering_provenance` tells the reader whether the ordering was observed/declared/synthesized/proposed (plan §1a#4).
$comment: ADVISORY schema (NOT the determinism-hashed fact-model core): no `arch validate` wiring and no schema/CHANGELOG core entry — validated INLINE by the producer (stages/scenarios.py) and tests via validate_facts.find_schema('dynamic-view.schema.json') + jsonschema.validate, exactly the enrich_llm.py pattern for llm-output / llm-narrative. `dynamic-view/2` is a SUPERSET of the (file-less) `dynamic-view/1` string constant: it preserves every /1 field (schema, scenario, slug, name, scope, derived_from_hash, steps, valid_steps, flagged_steps, note) and FOLDS IN AT ONCE all the dynamic-view-generation-plan fields so there is no later churn — evidence_layer, dsl, dsl_reason, dsl_steps, order, ordering_provenance, from_name, to_name, reason, weight. derived_from_hash = content_hash(facts_emitted) (emission-normalized provenance, plan §0.4#4), NEVER the serve If-Hash freshness comparator. Step rows are a status-discriminated union (ok | unresolved | unevidenced): the schema lists the union of all step fields with additionalProperties:false and requires only the common ones (index, order, from_raw, to_raw, status); status determines which optionals are present.

schema.description: The advisory schema id; matches the DYNAMIC_VIEW_SCHEMA constant in stages/scenarios.py.

scenario.description: The authored scenario key (rules/scenarios.yaml) or the candidate proposal key.

slug.description: Filesystem/URL-safe slug for the scenario key; drives the <slug>.json filename and the serve GET /model/dynamic/<scenario> lookup.

scope.description: The dynamic-view scope: the literal 'system' or a container the view drills into.

ordering_provenance.description: How the step ORDERING was arrived at (plan §1a#4 / §0.4#5). The validator never validates order, so this is the reader's trust signal; it survives promotion into scenarios.yaml. Defaults to 'hand-authored' for the existing rules/scenarios.yaml path.

derived_from_hash.description: content_hash(facts_emitted) — honest provenance of exactly the emission-normalized facts the steps were validated against (plan §0.4#4). NOT the serve If-Hash freshness comparator (that is the envelope curated hash).

steps.description: Authored steps in declaration order — every step kept (honest abstention); a flagged step is reported, never dropped.

index.description: 1-based sequential position (the renumber-proof DSL/GUI step number).

order.description: The non-unique parallel-band index (plan §2/§3.1#5): concurrent / fan-out steps share an `order`; defaults to the sequential position when the proposal omits it.

status.description: ok = (from,to) is an evidenced build OR runtime container edge; unresolved = an endpoint does not name a container/build target; unevidenced = both resolve but no evidenced container edge exists.

from_name.description: Source container display name — the SequenceStrip lane label.

to_name.description: Target container display name — the SequenceStrip lane label.

reason.description: Human explanation for a flagged step (unresolved / unevidenced).

description.description: The step message (label policy §1a#2 — never a bare 'Uses' for the LLM/runtime paths).

evidence_layer.description: Which evidence layer backs an `ok` step. 'build' wins ties (the stronger structural layer); 'runtime' is a .WithReference-class deployment edge (plan §0.3).

dsl.description: True iff this step is emittable to a Structurizr `dynamic{}` block (a static container relationship exists). Build-backed ok steps are dsl:true; runtime-only ok steps are dsl:false (plan §0.4#3).

dsl_reason.description: Why a runtime-only ok step is dsl:false (no static container relationship for Structurizr to reference).

weight.description: Sum of contributing build-edge weights; null/omitted for runtime-only steps (runtime edges carry no relationships[] weight, plan §3.1#1).

cited_edges.description: The contributing target-level edges (citation tooltip). Build steps cite relationships[]; runtime steps cite deployment.edges[].

valid_steps.description: Count of status==ok steps (build-backed + runtime-only). Runtime-only steps are valid but not DSL steps (plan §3.1#4).

dsl_steps.description: Count of steps emitted to Structurizr DSL (ok AND dsl:true).

note.description: Provenance-aware note: the existence of every step is validator-checked, but call order is never treated as observed unless the source observed it (parameterized by ordering_provenance, plan §0.4#5).
